note: The module adds a CKEditor 5 toolbar item 'customTable' (label 'Responsive Table') declared in ckeditor_responsive_table.ckeditor5.yml. Enabling it per text format stores 'customTable' in editor.editor.<format> settings.toolbar.items. A separate admin form (route ckeditor_responsive_table.form) writes ckeditor_responsive_table.settings: table_selector, fail_class (default tabled--stacked), caption_side, large/small_character_threshold. info.yml has no 'configure' key so configure=null. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config: the settings config object and namespaced crt_* text-format/editor entities created for the eval.

evals.prompt: I installed the CKEditor 5 Responsive Table module. How do I actually enable the responsive table button for editors on a given text format, and what is the CKEditor 5 toolbar item id involved?
evals.expected_output: Go to /admin/config/content/formats, Configure a CKEditor 5 format, drag the 'Responsive Table' button into the Active toolbar and save. This adds the toolbar item 'customTable' to editor.editor.<format> settings.toolbar.items.

evals.prompt: Which configuration object holds the CKEditor Responsive Table front-end settings, and what is the default 'fail class' applied to a table that cannot be made responsive?
evals.expected_output: Config object ckeditor_responsive_table.settings holds table_selector, fail_class (default tabled--stacked), caption_side (top/bottom), and large/small_character_threshold. Edited at /admin/config/content/ckeditor-responsive-table.

evals.prompt: How is the table produced by the CKEditor 5 Responsive Table module different from the table produced by CKEditor's built-in table button?
evals.expected_output: The built-in table button is not responsive. This module's tables are accessible by default and collapse/stack on narrow screens (using a data-label based 'tabled' script), with controls for rows, columns, headers, and a caption (visible or hidden).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the CKEditor Responsive Table module's settings have been customized. Inspect the live configuration and state which side the table caption is configured to appear on.
evals.expected_output: caption_side is 'bottom' in ckeditor_responsive_table.settings (read via `drush config:get ckeditor_responsive_table.settings caption_side`).

evals.prompt: One of the text formats on this site has the CKEditor 5 Responsive Table button enabled in its toolbar. Inspect the editor configuration and give the machine name of that text format.
evals.expected_output: The format crt_medium has 'customTable' in editor.editor.crt_medium settings.toolbar.items.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the CKEditor Responsive Table module so that table captions are rendered at the BOTTOM of the table (not the top). Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: ckeditor_responsive_table.settings caption_side is set to 'bottom' (e.g. `drush config:set ckeditor_responsive_table.settings caption_side bottom -y`).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a CKEditor 5 text format with machine name crt_hard. Add the CKEditor 5 Responsive Table button to that format's active toolbar so editors can insert responsive tables, and apply the change to the live site.
